2027-06-06.title: Third Sunday after Pentecost
readings: The Twelve sent out two by two
We will not worship the golden statue
Through this man forgiveness of sins is proclaimed
I am the bread of life
2027-06-06.verse: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

2027-06-20.title: Fifth Sunday after Pentecost
readings: Whoever wants to be first must be servant of all
Three times a year you shall keep a festival
I will be like the dew to Israel
Those who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength
Ananias and Saul: a chosen instrument
We are the temple of the living God
You give them something to eat
2027-06-20.verse: Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all.

2027-06-27.title: Sixth Sunday after Pentecost
readings: Increase our faith; we are worthless slaves
Some take pride in chariots, but our pride is in the name of the Lord
Paul at the Areopagus: in him we live and move
2027-06-27.verse: Just so, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance.

2027-06-29.title: Sts Peter and Paul, Apostles
readings: You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church
Daniel resolves not to defile himself
I have called you by name, you are mine
An angel frees Peter from prison
I have fought the good fight
2027-06-29.verse: And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

2027-06-13.title: Fourth Sunday after Pentecost
readings: The Lord sends out the seventy
Moses blesses the tribes of Israel
The Lord has given you the city
Who may abide in your tent?
There is a blessing in the cluster
Seven men full of the Spirit and of wisdom
Rejoice that your names are written in heaven
2027-06-13.verse: Nevertheless, do not rejoice at this, that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

2027-06-01.title: Tuesday of the second week after Pentecost · St Justin
readings: The household of God, the pillar and bulwark of the truth; the great mystery of our religion
“When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will realize that I am he”
2027-06-01.verse: Without any doubt, the mystery of our religion is great: He was revealed in flesh, vindicated in spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among Gentiles, believed in throughout the world, taken up in glory.

2027-06-02.title: Wednesday of the second week after Pentecost
readings: The message about the cross: foolishness to some, the power of God to us
The kingdom of God is like a mustard seed and like yeast
2027-06-02.verse: For the message about the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

2027-06-03.title: Thursday of the second week after Pentecost
readings: Those who believe are blessed with Abraham; we receive the promise of the Spirit through faith
The house swept and put in order, and the seven spirits
2027-06-03.verse: in order that in Christ Jesus the blessing of Abraham might come to the Gentiles, so that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

2027-06-04.title: Friday of the second week after Pentecost · Memory of Most Rev. Geevarghese Mar Timotheos
readings: Remember your leaders; Jesus suffered outside the city gate; we have an altar
The faithful and wise slave whom the master finds at work
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep
“I am the way, and the truth, and the life”
“No one has greater love than this”
2027-06-04.verse: Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the city gate in order to sanctify the people by his own blood. Let us then go to him outside the camp and bear the abuse he endured.

2027-06-05.title: Saturday of the second week after Pentecost · St Boniface
readings: From childhood you have known the sacred writings; all scripture is inspired by God
“David himself calls him Lord; so how can he be his son?”
2027-06-05.verse: All scripture is inspired by God and is useful for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness, so that everyone who belongs to God may be proficient, equipped for every good work.

2027-06-07.title: Monday of the third week after Pentecost
readings: Lifting up holy hands without anger; adorned with good works
The Advocate will teach you everything; “Peace I leave with you”
2027-06-07.verse: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled, and do not let them be afraid.

2027-06-08.title: Tuesday of the third week after Pentecost · St Mariam Thresia
readings: A person is justified not by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ
The Spirit of truth will testify on my behalf; you also are to testify
2027-06-08.verse: You also are to testify because you have been with me from the beginning.

2027-06-09.title: Wednesday of the third week after Pentecost
readings: They exchanged the truth about God for a lie
“I am the resurrection and the life. Do you believe this?”
2027-06-09.verse: I am the resurrection and the life. Those who believe in me, even though they die, will live

2027-06-10.title: Thursday of the third week after Pentecost
readings: Epaphroditus came close to death for the work of Christ: honor such people
When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth
2027-06-10.verse: When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth

2027-06-11.title: Friday of the third week after Pentecost · Mar Barthulmai Shleeha and Mar Barnabas · Foundation Day of the Syro-Malankara Catholic Hierarchy
readings: Justified by faith, we have peace with God; God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit
“We will come to them and make our home with them”
2027-06-11.verse: Those who love me will keep my word, and my Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.

2027-06-12.title: Saturday of the third week after Pentecost
readings: My heart's desire and prayer to God for them is that they may be saved
If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, nothing will be impossible for you
2027-06-12.verse: For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

2027-06-14.title: Monday of the fourth week after Pentecost · Elisha the Prophet
readings: Present your members to God as instruments of righteousness
None of them was cleansed except Naaman the Syrian
2027-06-14.verse: There were also many lepers in Israel in the time of the prophet Elisha, and none of them was cleansed except Naaman the Syrian.

2027-06-15.title: Memory of the first church built in the name of the Mother of God · Tuesday of the fourth week after Pentecost
readings: In whatever condition you were called, there remain with God
The true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth
2027-06-15.verse: But the hour is coming, and is now here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such as these to worship him.

2027-06-16.title: The Apostles' Fast begins · Wednesday of the fourth week after Pentecost
readings: Servants of Christ and stewards of God's mysteries
Jesus gives authority to the Twelve; the names of the twelve apostles
2027-06-16.verse: Moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found trustworthy.

2027-06-17.title: Thursday of the fourth week after Pentecost
readings: Rooted and built up in Christ; the record against us nailed to the cross
The house built on rock and the house without a foundation
2027-06-17.verse: As you therefore have received Christ Jesus the Lord, continue to live your lives in him, rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding in thanksgiving.

2027-06-18.title: Friday of the fourth week after Pentecost · Mar Aprem Malpan (St Ephrem the Syrian)
readings: The law has only a shadow of the good things to come
I have called you friends; love one another as I have loved you
2027-06-18.verse: I do not call you servants any longer, because the servant does not know what the master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I have heard from my Father.

2027-06-19.title: Saturday of the fourth week after Pentecost · Mar Yuda Thaddai Shleeha (St Jude the Apostle)
readings: “See, God, I have come to do your will”: sanctified through the offering of the body of Christ
Do not resist an evildoer; go the second mile; love your enemies
2027-06-19.verse: But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

2027-06-21.title: Monday of the fifth week after Pentecost · St Aloysius Gonzaga
readings: Slaves of sin or slaves of righteousness: the end is eternal life
Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all
2027-06-21.verse: Whoever welcomes one such child in my name welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes not me but the one who sent me.

2027-06-22.title: Tuesday of the fifth week after Pentecost
readings: The one who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully: God loves a cheerful giver
Store up treasures in heaven: where your treasure is, there your heart will be also
2027-06-22.verse: for God loves a cheerful giver.

2027-06-23.title: Wednesday of the fifth week after Pentecost
readings: Tychicus, a dear brother and faithful minister, sent to encourage your hearts
“Lord, I believe”: the man born blind sees, and those who say “We see” remain blind
2027-06-23.verse: He said, “Lord, I believe.” And he worshiped him.

2027-06-24.title: The Birth of John the Baptist · Thursday of the fifth week after Pentecost
readings: Pursue peace with everyone, and the holiness without which no one will see the Lord
“His name is John”: the birth of the forerunner
Remember your leaders, those who spoke the word of God to you, and imitate their faith
The faithful and wise servant whom the master finds at work

2027-06-25.title: Friday of the fifth week after Pentecost
readings: By faith Abraham offered up Isaac; by faith Isaac, Jacob and Joseph blessed the generations to come
“My teaching is not mine but his who sent me”; judge with right judgment
2027-06-25.verse: Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment.

2027-06-26.title: Saturday of the fifth week after Pentecost
readings: Your gift is a fragrant offering; my God will fully satisfy every need of yours
“Whoever is from God hears the words of God”
2027-06-26.verse: And my God will fully satisfy every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

2027-06-28.title: Monday of the sixth week after Pentecost · Mar Irenaeus
readings: Avoid wrangling over words; a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly explaining the word of truth
“You did not choose me but I chose you”: fruit that will last
2027-06-28.verse: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved by him, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly explaining the word of truth.

2027-06-30.title: The Twelve Apostles · Wednesday of the sixth week after Pentecost
readings: Servants of God: as having nothing, and yet possessing everything
He appointed twelve, to be with him and to be sent out to proclaim the message
2027-06-30.verse: And he appointed twelve, whom he also named apostles, to be with him, and to be sent out to proclaim the message,

St Boniface and the great oak
St Mariam Thresia and the lantern path

Mar Aprem, the harp of the Holy Spirit
